items.title: Optional Firefox account connection recovery
items.description: Opt-in account recovery can use configured subscription nodes to carry TLS-verified Firefox Accounts requests when the direct network is unavailable. No external browser login, and no automatic replay of an ambiguous password request.

items.title: Split tunneling on/off switch
items.description: A single setting turns application split tunneling on or off without deleting the saved app selection. When disabled all regular device applications use the VPN; per-app rules apply only while enabled.

items.title: Desktop account and verification reliability
items.description: The Windows app uses its native OS-aware account transport and a matching user agent to avoid helper-specific timeouts. Temporary login routes are cleared on completion or cancellation.

items.title: AppImage catalog-compatible SquashFS
items.description: The Linux AppImage uses gzip-compressed SquashFS, supported by the AppImage catalog mount tester, instead of its incompatible xz compression.

items.title: Standard AppImage filenames
items.description: Published AppImages are named PredatorVPN-2.0.5-x86_64.AppImage and PredatorVPN-2.0.5-aarch64.AppImage. DEB and RPM package names are unchanged apart from the version.

items.title: Consistent release version and links
items.description: Updated download links, release validation, and README branding, retaining the existing account, subscriptions, connection and regional HTTP 451 recovery behavior.
